scope: Bootstrap source-asset guardrails for the current first-district prototype; revise with measured production-asset evidence before replacing these models.
method: Triangle ceilings are 4x the committed baseline. Material ceilings are 4x except the four-part sedan's 2x grouped reserve; texture limits reserve explicit authored slots rather than multiplying today's mostly-zero baseline. Texture limits count resources, not bytes or GPU residency; resolution/memory limits remain governed by the M12 VRAM tracker until representative production textures exist.
